artifacts.name: test_executing_node_green_red_green_is_positive_detection_proof
artifacts.description: Scenario: an executing node is stable green; action: mutate then restore; expected: the green-red-green node proof detects the mutant.

artifacts.name: test_focused_candidate_that_stays_green_runs_original_command
artifacts.description: Scenario: attributed nodes do not fail; action: run focused candidate; expected: the original command still executes before any non-detection result.

artifacts.name: test_source_or_ast_inspection_detector_is_found_by_exact_fallback
artifacts.description: Scenario: a non-executing node inspects source/AST; action: mutate the body; expected: exact fallback discovers its mutation-caused failure.

artifacts.name: test_fixture_or_order_dependent_candidate_is_inconclusive_and_falls_back
artifacts.description: Scenario: focused selection changes fixture/order outcomes; action: compare controls; expected: no focused proof is accepted and the exact command runs.

artifacts.name: test_collection_time_detector_is_found_by_exact_fallback
artifacts.description: Scenario: collection inspects the source; action: mutate before collection; expected: exact fallback attributes the collection transition.

artifacts.name: test_subprocess_observer_without_context_is_found_by_exact_fallback
artifacts.description: Scenario: a child process observes the file without in-process contexts; action: mutate; expected: exact fallback detects the transition.

artifacts.name: test_baseline_failing_original_command_is_harness_failure_not_detection
artifacts.description: Scenario: the original command already fails; action: run knockout; expected: nonzero gate output carries E712 instead of a false detected result.

artifacts.name: test_baseline_target_mutation_fails_closed_before_mutant_overwrite
artifacts.description: Scenario: an unmutated baseline command changes target bytes; action: prepare the mutant; expected: E712 preserves the command-written bytes and never overwrites them with the planned mutation or stale restore.

artifacts.name: test_restored_control_target_mutation_fails_closed_and_restores_original_bytes
artifacts.description: Scenario: the restored control writes or deletes the target and either exits zero or raises; action: finish the differential lifecycle; expected: E712 recovers the original bytes before any next declaration.

artifacts.name: test_crlf_target_is_restored_byte_for_byte_after_successful_knockout
artifacts.description: Scenario: the target uses CRLF bytes and a newline observer cannot detect the artifact; action: mutate and restore; expected: mutation-time lines preserve CRLF and the final target bytes exactly equal the original input.

artifacts.name: test_stale_runtime_evidence_runs_exact_fallback
artifacts.description: Scenario: source or resolved environment identity changes after evidence collection; action: run knockout; expected: focused selection is rejected and the original exact command performs differential fallback.

artifacts.name: test_mutant_red_without_restored_green_is_inconclusive_and_falls_back
artifacts.description: Scenario: the post-restore control is red; action: attempt focused proof; expected: proof is rejected and a deterministic harness diagnostic/fallback is used.

artifacts.name: test_proven_focused_detector_avoids_broad_original_command
artifacts.description: Scenario: stable focused proof exists; action: execute knockout; expected: the broad command call count stays zero without skipping any inconclusive case.

artifacts.name: test_differential_and_legacy_honest_fixture_gate_quality_is_monotonic
artifacts.description: Scenario: honest and unrelated-failure fixtures; action: compare old/new decisions; expected: honest detection remains and unrelated failure no longer satisfies the gate.

artifacts.name: test_duplicate_spec_declarations_restore_target_before_next_legacy_side_effect_sequence
artifacts.description: Scenario: the first declaration writes project state; action: execute both declarations; expected: target restore/reapply points, side-effect order, and reports match separate legacy declaration runs.

artifacts.name: test_differential_proof_text_and_json_expose_same_detector_and_fallback
artifacts.description: Scenario: focused and fallback detections; action: render verify text/JSON; expected: identical detector, fallback, and structured error attribution.

artifacts.name: test_deep_verify_passes_runtime_evidence_to_focused_knockout
artifacts.description: Scenario: artifact coverage collected complete node evidence alongside active manifests with no knockout targets; action: run public verify with coverage and knockout; expected: knockout validates the relevant evidence projection and reports focused proof without exact fallback.
